caption:
Calling all artists and creative minds! 📣 Join us for «InspireFest» on May 3, 2024, from 3 PM to 7 PM at Astana Hub in Astana, where art meets AI to explore and shape the national identity. Our theme «Our Steps into the Future» delves into our cultural roots, visions of AI’s role in our society and future✨

🚀 What’s in it for you?
- A unique opportunity to demonstrate your creativity on the important Astana Hub platform, where your ideas can find new fans and admirers of art.
* Wide audience and the opportunity to participate in discussions about the role of art in modern society, including the impact of artificial intelligence on the future and cultural traditions.
* Opportunity to interact with professionals in the field of art and technology at lectures and meetings.

👩‍🎨Art curator: @elmira_kandyart 

Various mediums are accepted: digital and traditional painting, photo and video materials, installations. 

Don’t miss this chance to inspire and be inspired!

🔗 Register link is in BIO
Deadline-April 23, 2024. All works will be selected, and after processing the applications, we will contact you to clarify details and confirm participation by the 26th.

#Inspirefest24 #chevronkazakhstan #usinkz #makerspacekz #astanahub
